data.content_provenance: Original brief description and factual resources reviewed against primary source.
data.content_use_scope: Source-linked metadata and original summary only; no approval to redistribute publisher text, diagrams, images or video.
data.equipment: Basketballs and basket; some players start without a ball.
data.instructions: At each basket, players with balls attack while others defend, block or rebound. Securing a ball changes defense to offense; change attacking positions each minute.
data.participants: Multiple players at each basket; group size is not specified numerically.
data.primary_goal_provenance: project editorial classification, not publisher-certified assessment
data.space: Basket and nearby painted area; no numeric minimum floor dimensions stated.
data.use_conditions: Use only when the actual equipment, player roles, space, skill prerequisites and supervision are satisfied. Ask for missing facts; do not invent durations, rest, coach availability or solo adaptations. Apply adopted participation rules separately.

issues: Use only the reviewed variant and its stated resource/supervision conditions; unknown time and rest remain unknown.

context_limitations: References are evidence, not a feasibility, age-eligibility or safety certification. Use only complete reviewed variants and retain their conditions; ask about missing facts.

population_qualifications.advisory_ranges: Show applicable contextual guidance; do not invent a precedence rule or turn recommended lower values into required minimum training.
population_qualifications.overlapping_required_bounds: Use the most restrictive supported applicable bound as one conceptual check; do not score aliases twice. Age 14/grade 9 therefore uses 600 minutes for this prototype.
population_qualifications.population_matching: Match reported age category and separately reported grade category. Never infer grade from age. Project scope is 13–17.
population_qualifications.unknown_grade: A known applicable age-based bound remains usable; age 15–17 with unknown grade does not establish a grade-based rule.

applicability_assessment.basis: Population scope only; request mode, complete schedule and other required inputs remain unassessed.

corrections_and_qualifications: Publisher category facts are retained; overlap resolution is PROJECT_NBA_OVERLAP_CONSERVATIVE_V1, not asserted publisher precedence.
Count games, practices and focused structured basketball; exclude genuinely informal peer/self play. App-prescribed structured basketball counts by project policy.
Include known existing commitments. Components do not add time already inside a parent session. A cap is not a training target.
A known distinct-session lower bound above the cap establishes Violated. Met requires complete classified dated coverage; otherwise Unknown.
An explicit public schedule-completeness mechanism and checker implementation are needed before automatic Met results.
Retain concurrent-sport, multi-game and camp qualifications; the cap is not unconditional permission.
